$comment: The shared source of truth for every language binding. Derived from trustabl-guard/docs/trustabl-otel-attributes.md, where these names are RESERVED. Adding a key here is step two of three: amend that spec with a named producer and bump it first, then this manifest, then the code. Each binding has a test asserting it matches this file.

derived_from.status: these names are reserved in 1.2 and land as a 1.3 addition when this emitter ships; profile 1.0.0 is the list proposed for 1.3

fingerprint.serialization: RFC 8785 (JCS) after volatile fields are stripped; a value that cannot be canonicalized yields no fingerprint

not_emitted_here.$comment: Produced elsewhere. A binding that emits these creates a second producer for one key.
not_emitted_here.trustabl.agent.id: collector processor, from the join index
not_emitted_here.trustabl.constraint.id: the compiler; reserved enrichments are a separate revision
